content: {"phoneNote":"The typographic layout is clean and readable, but the 'Pia Lešnik, profesorica matematike' section repeats almost the exact same biography already stated in the hero intro.","desktopNote":"The asymmetric hero works well, but the lower sections are strictly left-aligned in a narrow column, leaving vast, unbalanced empty white space across the right half of the screen.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Remove or rewrite the 'Pia Lešnik, profesorica matematike' section so it does not repeat the exact same credentials and services already listed in the hero paragraph.","Use a two-column layout on desktop for the 'Kje poteka' and 'Pia Lešnik' sections (e.g., heading on the left, body text on the right) to balance the empty right side of the viewport.","Remove the 'Pokličite me' text link in the hero on mobile, as it sits right below the prominent burgundy 'Pokličite' header button."],"blockers":["Both phone and desktop repeat the exact same biographical section in the hero intro and the 'Pia Lešnik, profesorica matematike' block further down."]}
